storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP CamsCom Downloader makes it easy to record live streams and download videos from Cams.com.

How it works: Go to any model page on Cams.com. For live streams, click Start to begin capturing — the extension records the HLS stream in real-time and converts it to MP4 when you click Stop. For recorded videos, select your quality and click Download.

It handles LL-HLS streaming, Mouflon DRM decryption, and multi-CDN host probing automatically — no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required. Videos save directly to your Downloads folder in an organized CAMSCOM subfolder.

Key features:
- Live stream capture with Start/Stop controls and elapsed time tracking
- VOD video downloads from model pages
- Handles Mouflon HLS obfuscation automatically
- In-page download button right on the video player
- Quality selection from all available resolutions and frame rates
- Real-time download progress with segment counting
- Right-click context menu for quick captures
- Dark-themed UI with coral/pink accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to Cams.com and open a model page
3. Click the download button on the player or the extension icon
4. For live: Start/Stop capture. For VOD: Select quality and download — saved as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I record a live stream?
faq.answer: Go to any live model page on Cams.com. Open the extension popup or click the in-page download button. Select your quality and click Start. The extension records the stream in real-time. Click Stop when you're done — the recording saves as MP4.

faq.question: How do I download a recorded video?
faq.answer: Navigate to a model's video page (/{model}/videos/{id}). The extension detects the VOD automatically. Select your quality and click Download.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension parses the HLS master manifest and shows all available variants — typically multiple resolutions with frame rates (e.g., 1080p, 720p @ 60fps). Formats are sorted by quality (highest first).

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: Videos automatically save to a CAMSCOM subfolder inside your browser's default Downloads directory.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Why does it say the model is offline?
faq.answer: The model must be currently live for stream capture. For offline models, check their video page for recorded VOD content.

faq.question: Why does it say 'private show'?
faq.answer: The extension cannot capture private shows. Wait for the model to return to public broadcast.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. All stream processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored.
